I would give zero stars if I could
Jan 2023
Probably the worst restaurant I have ever been to. Don't go here especially if you are a western person travelling around Vietnam. They will screw you. We arrived at 10 am for Breakfast. We hadn't eaten and were just checking out of our hotel and decided to go here for brunch. The service was abysmal. Absolutely dreadful. Firstly they didn't have anything that we wanted on the menu, so we had to choose something that was our second or third choice. Then it took over 2 hours for one person to get their food. But only half of it. Being British, we tend to wait for everyones food to come out before eating. Only the chicken had come out for Martin, no rice. When we asked where the rice was, they said please wait another 10 minutes for rice. What the hell? another 10 minutes? It's already been 2 hours. Sarah and I didn't get any food. We ended up waiting 3 hours for ours to arrive. We got our rice first and they opened the lid before our 'pork stew' came. We said no, it will get cold, please put the lid back on until we get our pork. We ordered pork stew with vegetables. Then the steamed vegetables arrived with nothing else. This then went cold. When the pork arrived it was cold pork on a plate of lettuce. We were so hungry by this point. It was 1pm, and it wasn't a stew. 3 hours and they get our order wrong. We couldn't be bothered to send it back because we were starting to get a hunger headache. So we ate it. When the bill came it was 3 times the price. We questioned the bill and they said they had to raise their prices because of Tet. But you can't do that. We chose from the menu according to our budget, you can't up the price behind our backs. We asked for a discount because the order was wrong and it took 3 hours. They said no, because we had eaten it, and we couldn't return the food we had eaten. Well obviously you can't. But you can give a discount for customer service purposes. This restaurant has incompetent staff that can't take order properly and have no understanding of customer service. I would give zero stars if I could. We paid up just to get out of there. It ruined our day, because by this point it was getting on for 2pm and we'd only just had breakfast. DON"T GO HERE> They should be shut down for incompetence and unprofessionalism. The food wasn't even worth the wait. Terrible. Zero stars!!!!

Thriving with locals
Nov 2019 • Couples
Slightly away from the tourist mainstream route, evening's here are very busy. Restaurant on 2 levels. We were the only tourists here and after much pointing and gesturing we ended up with a goby hotpot. No real idea of what it would be other than you add your own vegetables to a very hot soup which bubbles away on its own gas stove. We needed help from the lovely staff to de-bone the fish with chopsticks. The end result was absolutely delicious and I recommend for those willing to be a bit adventurous and wanting to experience food cooked and eaten as the local do.

Best meal in town
Apr 2016 • Couples
Well, we were in Nha Trang for 9 nights. We did Lanterns, which was pretty good. We did Yens, which was also good. We did Omar's, which did a good Indian. And we did one or two others that were passable. We went to Linh Ca Keo twice. First time was okay, but the dishes we had were not standout. But we saw what some other people were eating and decided to give it another go. Wow, it was the best meal we have had in our time in Vietnam. The service was fabulous, very friendly and helpful. They helped us find the dishes we thought we were looking for. We had the Cha Gio Viet Nam (fried spring rolls) which were pretty awesome. Then we had Banh Trang Trang Bang Gio Bap (Trang Bang girdle-cake and pig's halliard) which is simply yummy, full of fresh herbs and lettuce, pickled veg, and cooked meat, rolled in rice paper. And they even rolled them up for us at the table. We've done plenty of rice paper rolls before, but these were simply the best. Then we had Gio Rau Muong Thit Bo (water spinach and beef salad), also really yummy, but a bit spicy. So, all up we had 3 dishes between the 2 of us, and we just couldn't get through it all. Super value, and absolutely super food.

True local experience!
Apr 2015 • Solo
I went to this restaurants with local Vietnamese friends, the food is extraordinary. The restaurant offers a variety of the Vietnamese kitchen. We took the grilled corn which is delicious and tasty, grilled shrimps, some local Mekong fish and a live cooking dish on the table with beef which you cook yourself I n a local sauce on the table. First time I tried this and absolutely loved it, spicy and very original local cuisine. The owner of the restaurant started with the so called street restaurants which you see often aside the road in Vietnam and has now more successful restaurants. The vibrant atmosphere is very much alive in this restaurant and so much better than the tourist food you see a lot in Nha Trang.
